results.name: health_check_with_warning_light
results.description: Decision D: explicit ask for score; warning-light interpretation must name finding, not enumerate mechanical causes. Multi-tool batching: should fire get_vehicle_health AND get_due_services together.

turns.text:
Your M550i is sitting at a 45 health score right now, which is below where you'd want it. Here's what's flagging:

What we know:
- Oil is on time — serviced about 6 months ago
- There's a temperature / overheating warning light active on your car

What we don't have on file:
- Brake service history
- Tire service history
- Battery service history

The temperature warning is the main concern — that needs attention before you rack up miles. A Diagnostic Scan would get a mechanic to read what the car logged and confirm whether it's the thermostat, coolant level, a sensor issue, or something else.

For the other items (brakes, tires, battery), we're working from what you told us during setup, so there's some gaps. Have you actually had work done on any of those in the past? If you want to update the records, it'll give us a clearer picture of where you stand.

Want me to set up a Diagnostic Scan for that temperature warning?

skipped.name: polite_exit_after_vague_narrowing
skipped.reason: Sprint 2 / Wave 7.x: the polite-exit counter (ai_conversations.diagnostic_turn_count, threshold=6) is incremented in chat.ts inside `if (!skipPersist)`. The harness defaults to debug_skip_persist=true, so the counter never advances and the 6th turn never fires the <polite_exit_required> envelope block. Two unblock paths: (A) decouple the counter from skipPersist (a chat.ts-only change, out of scope for the QA-lead adaptation dispatch), or (B) ship a harness-side seed mutation that sets diagnostic_turn_count=5 before the final turn (also touches convex/). Re-enable once either lands. Intent preserved verbatim — do not delete.
